# xterm.js

Vendored browser assets for the embedded worker terminal.

- `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0, MIT.
- `addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0, MIT.

The server-side PTY bridge (`node-pty` and `ws`) is optional and is not
vendored. Install it in the project root when the terminal is wanted.
